config.enable_compound_interest.name: 启用复利选项
config.enable_compound_interest.tooltip: 在银行界面显示复利计算选项。复利=本金+已获利息都计入下次计息。| Show compound interest option in bank UI. Compound = base + earned interest all earn interest.
config.enable_simple_interest.name: 启用单利选项
config.enable_simple_interest.tooltip: 在银行界面显示单利计算选项。单利=只有原始本金计入计息。| Show simple interest option in bank UI. Simple = only original base amount earns interest.
config.enable_negative_interest.name: 启用负利率选项
config.enable_negative_interest.tooltip: 允许利率为负值，导致存款可能亏损。| Allow interest rate to be negative, which may cause losses on deposits.
config.current_interest_type.name: 当前利率类型
config.current_interest_type.tooltip: 显示当前使用的利率计算方式
config.interest_type_hint: 提示：在银行界面点击切换按钮可更改利率类型
config.enable_luck_influence.name: 启用运气影响
config.enable_luck_influence.tooltip: 每日运气值（Daily Luck）影响存款利率。| Daily Luck affects deposit interest rate.
config.luck_multiplier.name: 运气影响倍数

config.enable_weather_influence.name: 启用天气影响

config.rain_bonus.name: 雨天加成

config.snow_bonus.name: 雪天加成

config.lightning_bonus.name: 雷暴加成
